extras: Supports Style Settings plugin for customization; future plans include system file explorer integration.
intentEvidence: A sidebar panel for Obsidian that shows file info, text statistics, and a document outline — without touching your frontmatter.
problem: Users need a centralized, non-intrusive way to view comprehensive file metadata, statistics, and document structure without editing frontmatter.

relations.evidence: Sidebar styling draws on the approach used by Simple File Info (Lukas Capkovic)
EXIF parsing is handled by exifr (Mike Kovařík)

summary: A sidebar panel that displays detailed file information, text statistics, document outlines, and image metadata without modifying frontmatter.
